_comment: Shared test cases for the poker formulas. Both web/src/math/formulas.ts (TypeScript) and crates/poker-core/src/math.rs (Rust) are tested against this file, so the two implementations can't drift apart. Arguments are in the order each function takes them; null means 'no answer' (e.g. implied odds with zero equity). Most cases are the worked examples from the plan's math reference.

equity.note: a three-way tie counts a third

impliedOdds.note: no equity: no amount of future winnings helps

outs.note: flush draw, turn to river (Rule of 2 says 18%)
flush draw, flop to river (Rule of 4 says 36%)
Rule of 4 says 60%: the shortcut drifts high

pairCombos.note: you hold one card of the rank

unpairedCombos.note: you hold the ace of spades on a king-high board
